scope: Read complete Eye proposal and obligations. Inspected actual Cleric Conviction capacity, Crimson Agent Spill Control, Mirrorsage archive slots, Oracle Burden/BoonIV and Warrior Flesh Warden sources. This does not review all seventeen classes or accept a new cross-class suppression engine.

reviewRequirements.question: The original12unit/10cap case is still arithmetic without a legal matching feature and an independent surviving spend permission. Actual Cleric Conviction has base3, automatic5 at level9, selectable+2 Conviction Pool (5early/7from9), not a12unit cap; its ordinary spending/recovery permissions are class features covered by Eye. Actual Crimson Agent Spill Control replaces3 with6 and grants no balance. Neither can silently be relabeled12/10 or spend through a suppressed class engine. Preserve the original obligation explicitly if unavailable; a real6to3 or7to5 case can be separately labeled. Any Eye-only conserved reserve requires an explicit director choice and complete no-refill/partial-return/permanent-loss/nested-cause accounting, not promotion to a global capacity rule.

Warrior Flesh Warden at actual Warrior10 supplies the original+20 formula while equipped, provided Basic Vital/slot/acquisition/body and base60HP are fully sourced. Preserve75/80 to60/60 to60/80, without a second damage subtraction or healing on return. If another fixture is selected, retain the original75/80 obligation separately. For Wizard Conjuration versus Flesh Ascendant remote dependents, classify recorded creation amount independently from continuing class authority and current controller. Do not infer that all snapshot amounts disappear, or that every remote body loses its source, solely from the term class-created. Suppression restores no original initial HP, attack phase, command, corpse or source slot.

Mirrorsage Echo Slot ExpansionII is5replacing3; Sacred slot is restricted and total<=6; Floating Memory's actual temporary slot is erased at encounter end. These are identified records, not interchangeable RP. Keep original consumed/replay/backup/provenance and absolute6record limit. A slot whose independent encounter-end deletion occurs during Eye cannot be restored when Eye ends. Actual unacquired cards remain source history only. An inaccessible record is not a new inert backup or a freely transferable physical item. Distinguish the engine's retained base identity/schedule from suppressible feature outputs for all representative pools.

Oracle Burden card8 is automatic at2, while intrinsic Curse limitations already require their own source treatment. Soul-Cracked BoonIV card46 requires actual Oracle15 and selected Soul-Cracked: its direct-Divination d2=1 result is contradictory but non-fabricated symbolic information, not a random class sheet. Its+2 against mind control does not apply merely because Eye calls for WIS. Resolve the WIS and original information protections before any suppression; do not retry the read afterward or expose a roster through blocked-output diagnostics. An actual empty class roster differs from an unclassified NPC. Provide a source-linked seventeen-class classification matrix with explicit unsupported entries rather than declaring all classes exercised by two examples.

Demonstrate actual paid Ready spell release versus unavailable new class casting, class form/meld/body conflict, remote dependent HP, finite resource/record holders and overlapping Eye/Antimagic endings. Whole underlying class engines are not dispelled by generic Antimagic, but their explicitly magical local expressions can be suppressed while Eye itself is suppressed, so no blanket restore-all is valid. Preserve actual target-END clock excluding the underway turn, original virtual markers, missed recoveries, custody, currentHP and immutable initial-read view. Supply all13 original answers plus these5 (18 total), full before/after/inverse changes and exact holds. Do not import pending Time5 or another unfinished ordinary spell as accepted authority; Body8 is accepted only by exact126 receipt and retained scope. No runtime or complete-class validation is implied.
